requirement: This code should implement a function block named FB_TripleAxisPower that controls the power settings of three axes (X, Y, and Z) and monitors their readiness and error states. It takes as input references to each axis (AxisX, AxisY, AxisZ of type SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3) and a boolean signal (bServoEnable) to enable the servo. The outputs include readiness states for each axis (bAxisXReady, bAxisYReady, bAxisZReady) and a combined readiness state (bReady), along with an error flag (bError) and an error string (sErrorString). The function block should activate each axis's power control with the servo enable signal and update the readiness states based on the status of each axis's power control block. It should also prioritize error handling for the X axis over the Y and Z axes, updating the error flag and string accordingly if any errors are detected.
provide_code:
FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_TripleAxisPower
VAR_INPUT
	AxisX			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//X轴引用
	AxisY			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Y轴引用
	AxisZ			:	SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3;			//Z轴引用
	bServoEnable	:	BOOL;				//伺服使能信号
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
	bReady			:	BOOL;				//三轴都准备就绪
	bAxisXReady		:	BOOL;				//X轴准备就绪
	bAxisYReady		:	BOOL;				//Y轴准备就绪
	bAxisZReady		:	BOOL;				//Z轴准备就绪
	bError			:	BOOL;				//错误标志
	sErrorString	:	STRING;				//错误信息字符串
END_VAR
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个名为 FB_TripleAxisPower 的功能块，用于控制三个轴（X轴、Y轴和Z轴）的电源设置，并监控它们的就绪状态和错误状态。它输入每个轴的引用（AxisX、AxisY、AxisZ 类型为 SM3_Basic.AXIS_REF_SM3）和一个布尔信号（bServoEnable）以启用伺服。输出包括每个轴的就绪状态（bAxisXReady、bAxisYReady、bAxisZReady）和组合就绪状态（bReady），以及一个错误标志（bError）和错误字符串（sErrorString）。功能块应当使用伺服启用信号激活每个轴的电源控制，并根据每个轴的电源控制块的状态更新就绪状态。它还应优先处理 X 轴的错误，如果检测到任何错误，相应地更新错误标志和字符串。
